description: This is a database migration script for the Apache Superset project, using Alembic. It modifies the 'params' field of 'slices' with 'pivot_table_v2' visualization type, migrating 'legacy_order_by' to 'series_limit_metric' during upgrade, and reversing this during downgrade.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing the 'slices' table, with fields 'id', 'params', and 'viz_type'.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema/data migration to move 'legacy_order_by' to 'series_limit_metric' in 'params' for 'pivot_table_v2' slices.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the migration, moving 'series_limit_metric' back to 'legacy_order_by' in 'params' for 'pivot_table_v2' slices.
